_note: Frank's approach lines: the gate display shows no bar or ratio, so these four one-shot messages are how the player hears the Series A door getting closer. Each speaks at most once per run (latch.one_shot is spent at admission, so an MRR dip and re-cross never brings it back) and carries no number. The step comes from phase.series_a_approach, which counts PhaseGateSystem.APPROACH_PCTS marks cleared against the gate's own finance.mrr leaf; the bar is never in this file. This one: the first mark (about half the bar). The band is exact (step == 1), so a company that jumps a mark is not told it is halfway after it is further on.
speaker: char_mentor_frank
